name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection: Diabetic Retinopathy Benchmark
description: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection is an international clinical ophthalmology dataset curated by the Asia Pacific Tele-Ophthalmology Society (APTOS) in partnership with the Aravind Eye Hospital in India. The dataset comprises 5,590 high-resolution retinal fundus photographs (3,662 training and 1,928 test images) acquired across multiple rural screening clinics using distinct camera models and imaging conditions. Each image was evaluated and graded by medical experts on the international clinical diabetic retinopathy scale from 0 to 4: No DR (0), Mild (1), Moderate (2), Severe (3), and Proliferative DR (4). APTOS 2019 facilitates development of automated screening models to prevent preventable vision loss in underserved populations.
